messages:
leo: Fantasy finals tonight! who's streaming from the office? TV's free after 7. :tv: 

tara: I'm in. Bringing a bluetooth speaker and my terrible commentary. :microphone:

owen: Need to set the lineup 973 I benched my kicker last week and still won, sooooo confident.

vikram: @owen that kicker curse is real. also lowkey salty about trade veto yesterday. :angry:

mika: Trade drama recap plz? Missed the thread.

owen: Some people vetoed @tara's trade even though it was within rules. She tried to pick up a WR and swap a TE. Apparently "too lopsided."

tara: It was fair! I offered draft picks and a bench swap. No receipts though. :see_no_evil:

leo: Reminder: $10 buy-in. Winner gets the pot + a small trophy I carved from a 3D print. :trophy: Also MVP gets a neon sticker.

mika: I'll cover $10 in cash at 7:10. Who wants snacks? I'll buy one bag of chips and someone grab something healthier.

vikram: I'll bring oranges and granola bars. 

owen: I vote for wings but also respect the granola. :chicken:

kudos-bot: Congrats @tara for "Most Helpful Slack Thread" this week! :confetti_ball:

tara: Thanks @kudos-bot! I will accept the grace and the suspicion of rigging trades. :sweat_smile: 

leo: Quick poll: do we allow lineup changes during halftime? React with :white_check_mark: = yes, :x: = no

owen: :white_check_mark:

tara: :white_check_mark:

mika: :x:

leo: Looks like halftime swaps allowed. One rule: must be posted in the thread with time. No blind benching.

vikram: Also, reminder 4e2 if anyone wants to stream remotely, I'll drop a Zoom link in 30 mins.

mika: remote pls 4 me. kid duty but love fantasy yell.

leo: Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/123456789 (passcode: snacks)

owen: Also, who drafted the unstoppable RB this season? Mine blew up then vanished. :face_with_rolling_eyes:

tara: That was me. Hes nursing an ankle. I'm on bench watch.

mika: Good luck y'all 3c6 may your waiver wire be blessed.
